title: Flow chamber adhesion assay for measuring arrest function of chemokines
protocol: Grow endothelial cells in 35 mm dishes until confluence.
Incubate dishes with PBS plus VCAM-1.Fc (0.5 μg/mL) for 4 h at 37°C if applicable.
Incubate cell monolayers with chemokine, e.g., 50 ng/mL MIF for 2 h.
Pre-incubate leukocytes with MIF for 2 min before the flow experiment if adding directly to leukocytes.
Incubate endothelial monolayers with monoclonal antibodies or isotype control for 30 min prior to the experiment.
Incubate leukocytes (1×10^6/mL) with calcein-AM (1-5 μM in assay buffer) for 30 min at 37°C.
Incubate cells with chemokine receptor-blocking antibodies or isotype control in assay buffer for 30 min at 37°C.
Wash and resuspend cells in assay buffer (0.5-1×10^6/mL).
Assess the 35 mm dish as the lower wall of the flow chamber and mount on a microscope stage.
Add one volume of assay buffer containing 2 mM Ca^2+^/Mg^2+^ (final concentration: 1 mM Ca^2+^/Mg^2+^) to the leukocyte samples.
After 2-5 min, quantify the number of adherent cells in multiple fields (0.24 mm² each, >10 per treatment) by analysis of images recorded with a long integration 3CCD video camera.
